projects.title: b0unty hunter plugin
projects.tagline: Custom Minecraft plugin development for Paper & Spigot
projects.body:
## Overview
BountySystem 0.1.0 is a high-performance Spigot/Paper plugin designed for physical item-based bounty hunting. Built with native diamond escrow, asynchronous GUI workflows, and full SQLite WAL audit logging.

## Core Features
- **Native Diamond Escrow:** Bounties deduct physical diamonds directly from inventory on placement and refund on cancellation.
- **Async GUI Framework:** 250ms debounced double-click protection preventing duplicate placements or item theft.
- **Private Chat Intercept:** Custom bounty amount entry is privately captured and never broadcasted to global server chat.
- **8-Character Tracking IDs:** Unique alphanumeric IDs generated for precise list management and command cancellation (`/bounty cancel <id>`).
- **Combat & Death Safeguards:** Bounties are awarded strictly on verified player kills. Environmental deaths (lava, falls, mobs) and self-claim exploits are automatically blocked.
- **SQLite Audit Ledger:** Built-in WAL mode transaction ledger for complete tracking and administrative resolution.

## Technical Stack
- **Target Platform:** Paper / Spigot 1.20+
- **Language:** Java 21
- **Database:** SQLite (WAL Mode)
- **Dependencies:** Standalone (No Vault required in native item mode)
